name: nurt
description:
Runs programs of the Nurt language.

Group git: Git repositories.

program.description: Program text in any notation variant.

ast.description: Surface syntax tree nurt-ast/1, equivalent to program. Pass the object as JSON text.

cursor.description: Cursor of a further page of an earlier result.

accept.description: Identifier of a candidate from an earlier E_AMBIGUOUS error.

preview.description: Only compute targets and effect; change nothing. Default: `false`.

base.description: Absolute directory against which relative paths are resolved.

limit.description: Records or changes per page. Default: `50`.

fields.description: Fields of the result to keep.

max_chars.description: Largest number of characters of a single text field; 0 means no limit. Default: `0`.

save_to.description: Absolute path of a file that receives the full result instead of the response.

timeout.description: Time limit of the whole program. Default: `120s`.

session.description: Session identifier recorded in the journal.

language.description: Language of messages and help. Default: `en`.

script.description: Script mode: several pipelines, each its own operation. Default: `false`.
